metadata.desc: Switch between daily persona chat and immersive roleplay per session. Isolates conversation histories, cleanses action styles from recalled long-term memories, optionally illustrates RP scenes with NovelAI images, and takes over RP-mode TTS with per-turn probability, audio+text dual output and parenthesized-action stripping.
metadata.short_desc: Per-session daily vs immersive roleplay mode switch with history isolation, memory style cleansing, probabilistic scene illustrations, and RP-controllable TTS.
